artifact_model.summary: OASIS-style artifacts are unique, rare items with special powers.

plutarch_version.claim: In Plutarch's account, Isis recovers the parts of Osiris except the male member; she makes a replica and consecrates the phallus.
plutarch_version.important_caveat: This is a Greco-Roman literary account of Egyptian religion, not proof that a surviving physical relic is the literal body part of Osiris.

our_osiris_search_thread.central_question: Could a museum object, sheath, insert, model, or undocumented internal component preserve a material tradition related to the 'missing member' motif?

tracked_candidates.verified_description: Made for insertion into a mould-made figure.

tracked_candidates.type: terracotta phallus associated with a figure
tracked_candidates.verified_description: Museum catalogue suggests it was probably applied to a figure identified as Harpocrates.

working_hypotheses: A candidate may be a standalone phallic model.
A candidate may be an insert originally mounted inside or onto a larger figure.
A sheath/cap may preserve the negative space or intended geometry of a now-separated component.
The sought object may never have been intended as a literal relic of Osiris; ritual representation is a separate hypothesis.
our_osiris_search_thread.hard_boundary: NO_CANDIDATE_IS_TO_BE_LABELLED 'THE ACTUAL PHALLUS OF OSIRIS' WITHOUT DIRECT CATALOGUE/PROVENANCE EVIDENCE.

visual.default_form: small dark-gold reliquary containing a deliberately abstract phallic-shaped fragment
visual.activation_effect: golden fragments orbit the target, leaving a blue-white seam where the missing component is reconstructed
visual.janus_compatibility_note: The visual can be rendered as two counter-rotating rings: LOSS / RETURN.

passive_power.name: ISIS TRACE
passive_power.effect: When the holder inspects an incomplete legendary object, broken quest-chain, fragmented map, vehicle, mech, gate, or relic-set, the artifact can identify that something essential is missing and reveal a directional trace toward the nearest valid missing component.
does_not_do: does not reveal the solution to the quest
does not name an unknown component automatically
does not fabricate evidence where no original component exists

active_power.name: RE-MEMBER
active_power.wordplay: member = body part; re-member = restore membership in the whole
active_power.effect: Reconstruct exactly ONE missing essential component of a target that is otherwise demonstrably the same incomplete object.
valid_targets: maps or coded objects split into physical components

identity_gate.minimum_condition: The target must contain sufficient surviving identity/provenance to prove which whole is being restored.

anti_abuse: cannot create a second copy of an existing unique item
cannot reconstruct an object that was intentionally consumed as the price of another artifact
cannot invent a component that never existed

death_trigger.name: HORUS PROTOCOL
death_trigger.effect: If the holder dies while the artifact is fully charged, it does NOT resurrect the holder. Instead it preserves one designated quest-critical possession or authorization token and transfers it to a pre-designated living ally/heir.
death_trigger.mythic_logic: Osiris does not simply return to ordinary mortal life; continuity passes forward through Horus.
death_trigger.balance_logic: This avoids duplicating the canonical 'extra life' niche represented by the 1981 Quarter.

cataclysm_rule.allowed_exception: A pre-bound Horus Protocol payload may survive as a lineage token if an eligible heir exists outside the destroyed zone.
cataclysm_rule.reason: The artifact preserves continuity; it is not a universal rewind button.

why_this_power_fits.short_answer: The funniest-looking relic gets one of the most serious powers in the OASIS: it makes incomplete things whole.

mapping.game_mechanic: ISIS TRACE finds the direction of missing components.

mapping.myth: The missing member is reconstructed symbolically.
mapping.game_mechanic: RE-MEMBER reconstructs one missing essential part.

mapping.myth: Death becomes continuity rather than simple return.
mapping.game_mechanic: HORUS PROTOCOL passes one critical state/item to an heir.

unlock_condition: Reconstruct the provenance chain without claiming certainty where none exists.
Choose the ritual representation over the tempting fake 'literal relic'.
rarity_and_quest.final_test: The player receives the artifact only after demonstrating that finding the truth is more important than finding the sensational answer.
rarity_and_quest.janus_registry_motto: THE MISSING PART RETURNS, BUT THE RECORD MUST REMAIN WHOLE.

evidence_ledger.supports: missing male member + Isis making a replacement
separate curved terracotta phallus designed for insertion into a figure
terracotta phallus probably applied to a Harpocrates figure
